articles.title: Why Payward-backed Reap is betting on non-USD stablecoins for 24/7 cross-border FX settlement
articles.snippet: Reap is preparing to add a Mexican peso stablecoin and is exploring Hong Kong dollar, euro, won and yen tokens for foreign exchange outside banking hours.

articles.title: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
articles.snippet: The country’s largest financial institutions are exploring tokenized deposits for interbank payments, just weeks after regulators clarified how they should be treated.

articles.title: White hats outrun Coldcard hackers in 52-Bitcoin evacuation
articles.snippet: White hats secured about 40% of the Bitcoin moved in the Coldcard exploit’s second wave, transferring it to a Wyoming trust for victims.

articles.title: Kakao Pay, KakaoBank to explore stablecoin opportunities with Fireblocks
articles.snippet: Kakao Pay and KakaoBank are exploring digital asset opportunities with Fireblocks, including infrastructure for stablecoins.

articles.title: White-Hat Hackers Route Coldcard Exploit Bitcoin Into 'Recovery Trust'
articles.snippet: Galaxy Research says white-hat actors consolidated coins tied to the exploit into a fresh address tagged for a "Crypto Recovery Trust," though the funds represent just 2.8% of the total haul.
